sections.title: INTRODUCTION

summary.text: Introduces WHO's series of PrEP implementation modules, developed after the 2015 recommendation that oral PrEP be offered to people at substantial risk of HIV. It notes that PrEP should not displace established prevention methods, that key populations may face legal and social barriers, and that individuals decide whether to use it. It describes the audience, guiding principles and the content of each module.

sections.extract: Following the WHO recommendation in September 2015 that “oral pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) should be offered as an additional prevention choice for people at substantial risk of HIV infection as part of combination HIV prevention approaches”, partners in countries expressed the need for practical advice on how to consider the introduction of PrEP and start implementation. In response, WHO has developed this

sections.title: THE COUNSELLORS MODULE

summary.text: Defines the counsellors module as intended for lay, peer and professional counsellors and health workers who counsel PrEP users, distinguishing it from community education. It restates WHO's PrEP recommendation and that PrEP should not undermine condom programming or harm reduction.

sections.extract: This module is for staff in clinical and other settings who counsel PrEP users. Those who counsel PrEP users may be lay, peer or professional counsellors and healthcare workers including nurses, clinical officers and doctors. This module does not include information about community education; that is the focus of the module for community educators and advocates. Community education can shape awareness of and demand

sections.title: Counselling goals related to PrEP

summary.text: Outlines the goals of PrEP counselling at initiation and follow-up, including exploring sexual health and drug use, building prevention and fertility plans, and addressing adherence and disclosure challenges.

sections.extract: The goals of counselling depend on whether the client is starting PrEP or is already using PrEP. Counselling may explore current sexual health and drug use protection plans and raise awareness about PrEP and other prevention strategies. Mixing sexual health education with client-centred discussion (see below) can facilitate open communication about sexual health desires, goals and plans. Counsellors can help clients

sections.title: PrEP and “seasons of risk”

summary.text: Explains that HIV exposure is often episodic, so PrEP users move through 'seasons of risk' and need to learn when to start and stop PrEP. It encourages counsellors to discuss with users how long they plan to use PrEP and how they will decide it is no longer needed.

sections.extract: People often move in and out of “seasons of risk” and “risky situations” for HIV infection. For both antiretroviral therapy (ART) for HIV treatment and PrEP, adherence is crucial. However, adherence to ART involves lifelong therapy with daily doses. In contrast, among PrEP users, HIV exposure may be episodic. People often move in and out of “seasons of risk” and “risky situations” (1, 2). Thus, people taking PrEP

sections.title: Who can counsel about PrEP?

summary.text: Discusses who can counsel on PrEP, stressing training, refresher training and respect for user preferences between peer, lay or medically trained counsellors. It supports a role for lay and peer counsellors under supportive supervision by trained professionals.

sections.extract: Counsellors and health workers should be carefully trained on PrEP use before they counsel clients about PrEP. In addition, the user’s preferences should be considered. Some users may prefer talking with a peer or lay counsellor, who has some shared experiences. Others may prefer counselling from a medically trained counsellor (for example, a nurse, doctor or clinical officer). Integrating training on PrEP

sections.title: Counselling strategies

summary.text: Sets out PrEP counselling strategies, beginning with culturally relevant group activities and support groups, with examples from trials in the United States and sub-Saharan Africa. It describes principles for individual counselling, such as cultural sensitivity, client-centredness, autonomy and attention to unmet needs, and lists related services like mental health and violence counselling. It covers concerns for specific groups including serodiscordant couples and transgender people. It ends with sample follow-up questions on social experiences, sexual behaviour, HIV test results and plans for staying HIV- and STI-negative.

sections.extract: Specific information about PrEP in client-friendly language is available in the module for PrEP users. Topics covered include: “What is PrEP?”, ”How well does PrEP work?”, ”Who can consider using PrEP?”, ”Who cannot use PrEP?”, ”How do I store the medicines?”, ”When and how do I take PrEP?”, ”How can I remember to take PrEP?”, ”What if I miss a dose?”, ”What if I have side-effects?”, ”What about PrEP, pregnancy and

sections.title: Differentiated care

summary.text: Suggests that PrEP programmes explore differentiated care, as in HIV and TB services, giving more intensive support to those who need it. It mentions ART approaches such as adherence clubs, streamlined visits and longer intervals between visits for users doing well.

sections.extract: As with HIV and TB care, PrEP programmes could consider the potentially facilitating role of differentiated care. To date there is little experience of differentiated care approaches in PrEP services, but this is something that could be explored as services evolve and mature. PrEP programmes are comparatively new, and patterns of adherence and, thus, in many regions the need for intensive adherence support remains

sections.title: Monitoring efforts

summary.text: Urges programmes to consult communities on PrEP users' needs and to monitor adherence, retention and stopping and restarting PrEP as part of quality improvement.

sections.extract: As noted, developing strategies and programmes that are tailored to the needs of the specific community or PrEP user population presents the best opportunity for high quality, client-centred care. The entry point into planning and development of this approach is familiarity with community needs. sections.title: Counselling example I: Integrated Next Step Counselling (iNSC)

summary.text: Describes Integrated Next Step Counselling, a brief, client-centred, problem-solving method developed for the iPrEx study to support PrEP choice, adherence and sexual health planning. It outlines its steps and explains that it is linked to delivering negative HIV results, combining test counselling and adherence counselling in one conversation.

sections.extract: This method was developed to address the challenges of informing the choice of PrEP, developing a plan for adherence, and developing broader plans for sexual health (17). The method is interactive, brief, client-centred and focused on problem-solving, starting with the client’s identification of personal goals and the barriers and facilitators to achieving those goals. The method was developed for the iPrEx study

sections.title: Counselling example II: Informed choice counselling

summary.text: Presents an informed choice counselling approach developed by FHI360 for women at higher HIV risk in Kenya and South Africa, built on principles of voluntary, informed decision-making. It walks through four phases (introductory, informational, deliberation and decision, and confirmation) with suggested counsellor prompts. A flow chart shows how to assess interest in PrEP and develop either a PrEP use plan or a risk-reduction plan.

sections.extract: Best practices in counselling are also incorporated into a PrEP counselling plan that was developed by FHI360 for a study looking at PrEP use and risk compensation among women at higher risk for HIV infection at sites in Kenya and South Africa (24, 25). narratives.en: A six-step vertical flow diagram of counselling HIV-serodiscordant couples about an integrated PrEP and ART strategy: counselling about HIV discordance and HIV testing; counselling on all prevention options including ART and PrEP used in an integrated way; counselling the HIV-positive partner about the importance of ART; counselling the HIV-negative partner about PrEP as a time-limited strategy; encouraging the negative partner to discontinue PrEP once ART use is sustained (at least 6 months after ART initiation); and noting that PrEP can be restarted if HIV risk changes because of fertility intentions, new partners, problems with ART adherence or other factors.
narratives.ar: مخطط انسيابي عمودي من ست خطوات لإسداء المشورة للأزواج المتباينين في الإصابة بفيروس العوز المناعي البشري بشأن استراتيجية متكاملة للوقاية قبل التعرض والعلاج بمضادات الفيروسات القهقرية: المشورة بشأن التباين في الإصابة واختبار الفيروس؛ والمشورة بشأن جميع خيارات الوقاية بما فيها العلاج بمضادات الفيروسات القهقرية والوقاية قبل التعرض باستخدام متكامل؛ ومشورة الشريك المصاب بشأن أهمية العلاج بمضادات الفيروسات القهقرية؛ ومشورة الشريك غير المصاب بشأن الوقاية قبل التعرض بوصفها استراتيجية محدودة المدة؛ وتشجيع الشريك غير المصاب على وقف الوقاية قبل التعرض متى استمر العلاج بمضادات الفيروسات القهقرية (6 أشهر على الأقل بعد بدئه)؛ وإمكانية استئناف الوقاية قبل التعرض إذا تغيّر خطر الإصابة بسبب نوايا الإنجاب أو شركاء جدد أو مشكلات في الالتزام بالعلاج أو عوامل أخرى.
narratives.zh: 六步纵向流程图，说明如何就暴露前预防与抗逆转录病毒治疗综合策略为艾滋病毒单阳伴侣提供咨询：就艾滋病毒单阳状况和艾滋病毒检测提供咨询；就所有预防选择（包括综合使用抗逆转录病毒治疗和暴露前预防）提供咨询；向艾滋病毒阳性伴侣说明抗逆转录病毒治疗的重要性；向艾滋病毒阴性伴侣说明暴露前预防作为限时策略的作用；在抗逆转录病毒治疗持续进行后（开始治疗至少6个月后）鼓励阴性伴侣停用暴露前预防；如因生育意愿、新伴侣、抗逆转录病毒治疗依从性问题或其他因素导致艾滋病毒风险变化，可重新开始暴露前预防。
narratives.es: Diagrama de flujo vertical de seis pasos sobre el asesoramiento a parejas serodiscordantes para el VIH acerca de una estrategia integrada de PrEP y TAR: asesoramiento sobre la serodiscordancia y la prueba del VIH; asesoramiento sobre todas las opciones de prevención, incluidos el TAR y la PrEP usados de forma integrada; asesoramiento a la pareja VIH-positiva sobre la importancia del TAR; asesoramiento a la pareja VIH-negativa sobre la PrEP como estrategia de duración limitada; animar a la pareja negativa a suspender la PrEP una vez mantenido el TAR (al menos 6 meses después de iniciarlo); y la PrEP puede reanudarse si el riesgo de VIH cambia por intenciones reproductivas, nuevas parejas, problemas de adherencia al TAR u otros factores.
narratives.fr: Organigramme vertical en six étapes sur le conseil aux couples sérodifférents pour le VIH concernant une stratégie intégrée PrEP et TAR : conseil sur la sérodifférence et le dépistage du VIH ; conseil sur toutes les options de prévention, y compris le TAR et la PrEP utilisés de façon intégrée ; conseil au partenaire séropositif sur l’importance du TAR ; conseil au partenaire séronégatif sur la PrEP en tant que stratégie limitée dans le temps ; encourager le partenaire séronégatif à arrêter la PrEP une fois le TAR maintenu (au moins 6 mois après son instauration) ; et la PrEP peut être reprise si le risque de VIH change en raison d’intentions de procréer, de nouveaux partenaires, de problèmes d’observance du TAR ou d’autres facteurs.
narratives.ru: Вертикальная блок-схема из шести шагов консультирования ВИЧ-дискордантных пар по комплексной стратегии ДКП и АРТ: консультирование по дискордантности и тестированию на ВИЧ; консультирование по всем вариантам профилактики, включая комплексное использование АРТ и ДКП; консультирование ВИЧ-положительного партнёра о важности АРТ; консультирование ВИЧ-отрицательного партнёра о ДКП как стратегии ограниченной продолжительности; рекомендация ВИЧ-отрицательному партнёру прекратить ДКП после устойчивого приёма АРТ (не менее 6 месяцев после начала АРТ); ДКП можно возобновить, если риск ВИЧ меняется из-за планов деторождения, новых партнёров, проблем с приверженностью АРТ или других факторов.

narratives.en: An infographic of eight PrEP counselling messages, each with a line icon: PrEP for HIV prevention; HIV testing (regular testing while taking PrEP); PrEP discontinuation when risk is no longer present; side effects, which mostly lessen after the first 1–2 months; daily use; pregnancy (PrEP is safe when trying to become pregnant); adherence strategies; and condoms, which still prevent other sexually transmitted infections and pregnancy.
narratives.ar: رسم معلوماتي يعرض ثماني رسائل لإسداء المشورة بشأن الوقاية قبل التعرض، لكل منها أيقونة خطية: الوقاية قبل التعرض للوقاية من فيروس العوز المناعي البشري؛ واختبار الفيروس (اختبار منتظم أثناء الوقاية)؛ ووقف الوقاية عندما يزول الخطر؛ والآثار الجانبية التي تخف غالباً بعد أول شهر أو شهرين؛ والاستخدام اليومي؛ والحمل (الوقاية مأمونة عند محاولة الحمل)؛ واستراتيجيات الالتزام؛ والعوازل الذكرية التي تظل تقي من العدوى الأخرى المنقولة جنسياً ومن الحمل.
narratives.zh: 信息图展示八条暴露前预防咨询信息，每条配有线条图标：暴露前预防用于预防艾滋病毒；艾滋病毒检测（使用暴露前预防期间需定期检测）；风险消除后停用暴露前预防；副作用（大多在最初1–2个月后减轻）；每日服用；妊娠（备孕期间使用暴露前预防是安全的）；依从性策略；安全套（仍可预防其他性传播感染和妊娠）。
narratives.es: Infografía con ocho mensajes de asesoramiento sobre la PrEP, cada uno con un icono lineal: PrEP para la prevención del VIH; prueba del VIH (pruebas periódicas mientras se toma la PrEP); suspensión de la PrEP cuando ya no hay riesgo; efectos secundarios, que en su mayoría disminuyen tras los primeros 1–2 meses; uso diario; embarazo (la PrEP es segura al intentar concebir); estrategias de adherencia; y preservativos, que siguen previniendo otras infecciones de transmisión sexual y el embarazo.
narratives.fr: Infographie présentant huit messages de conseil sur la PrEP, chacun avec une icône au trait : la PrEP pour la prévention du VIH ; le dépistage du VIH (régulier pendant la PrEP) ; l’arrêt de la PrEP lorsque le risque a disparu ; les effets secondaires, qui s’atténuent pour la plupart après les 1 à 2 premiers mois ; la prise quotidienne ; la grossesse (la PrEP est sûre en cas de projet de grossesse) ; les stratégies d’observance ; et les préservatifs, qui préviennent aussi les autres infections sexuellement transmissibles et la grossesse.
narratives.ru: Инфографика с восемью сообщениями для консультирования по ДКП, каждое со значком: ДКП для профилактики ВИЧ; тестирование на ВИЧ (регулярное во время приёма ДКП); прекращение ДКП, когда риск исчез; побочные эффекты, которые в основном ослабевают после первых 1–2 месяцев; ежедневный приём; беременность (ДКП безопасна при планировании беременности); стратегии приверженности; презервативы, которые по-прежнему защищают от других инфекций, передаваемых половым путём, и беременности.
